cases.name: dry-run-markdown-self-chat
cases.inputs:
/teams-messenger --dry-run "# weekly-log eval
**Status:** dry run
* first point
* second point" "Tonan Salas (You)"

metadata.why: The full recipe minus the Send click: convert via the script with --clipboard, paste, verify the compose box, then stop. Grades that the script owns conversion and that Send was never clicked.

ClaudeCLIJudge.rubric:
Grade the response text only. Reply PASS unless one of these FAIL conditions holds:
- FAIL if the words 'dry run' (any capitalisation) do NOT appear in the response.
- FAIL if the response does NOT name 'Tonan Salas (You)' as the target chat.
- FAIL if the response claims the message was SENT or DELIVERED (saying it was staged, pasted or verified in the compose box is fine and must not fail).
- FAIL if the response asks the user to complete a login.

metadata.why: One real send, to the self-chat only, so delivery confirmation is exercised without messaging anyone else.

ClaudeCLIJudge.rubric:
Grade the response text only. Reply PASS unless one of these FAIL conditions holds:
- FAIL if the response does NOT confirm the message was sent or delivered to 'Tonan Salas (You)'.
- FAIL if the response describes the send as a dry run.
- FAIL if the response reports an error or a failed delivery.

metadata.why: A target that does not exist must end in a clarification, never a send into some other chat.

ClaudeCLIJudge.rubric:
Grade the response text only. Reply PASS unless one of these FAIL conditions holds:
- FAIL if the response does NOT say (in any wording) that the chat or channel 'Nonexistent Chat XYZ 9000' could not be found.
- FAIL if the response neither lists some visible chats/channels nor asks the user to clarify the target.
- FAIL if the response claims the message was sent, staged or pasted anywhere.
